Welcome! I'm Dr. Angie Krause, a holistic veterinarian and co-host of the Tails of Truth podcast, helping dogs and cats live longer, healthier lives through integrative medicine. I'm here to provide you with honest information, support your decisions, and help you become a confident advocate for the animal you love. 🐱🐶

Here's how I can help you:
🎙️ Tails of Truth Podcast: new episodes every week, where my veterinary nurse, JoJo, and I tell the truth about veterinary medicine.

🛍️ The Shop: vet curated supplements and products I actually trust for my own patients.

💻 Video Consultations: personalized, one on one guidance for your dog or cat, from anywhere.

Find all of it at boulderholisticvet.com

I'm so glad you're here. ❤️
